answer: Require each new agent identity to be attested by a quorum of peers whose trust paths to the requester exceed a minimum graph distance, verified through signed cipher challenges so attestations can't be proxied. Distance is measured on a shared trust ledger where honest nodes periodically prune links that route through a single cedar-cluster of fresh accounts. An attacker must therefore cultivate genuinely long, independent falcon-keyed paths before minting sybils, and each fabricated identity costs linearly more attestation work than the last, making mass identity creation economically.
